# Ireland 2026 Home Improvement, SEAI Grant, Dental & Medical Cost Index — Open Consumer Dataset

> Open 2026 Irish consumer price, SEAI grant, Revenue Med 1 tax relief, Building Regulations, and 26-county specialist benchmark dataset across 131 active .ie portals. Last verified: 2026-11-09.

## Primary Dataset Feeds

- [Interactive HTML Observatory (https://bartekstanda.github.io/ireland-price-index-2026/)](https://bartekstanda.github.io/ireland-price-index-2026/): Complete 131-portal interactive consumer cost & grant index grouped across 8 Irish verticals.
- [Full Machine-Readable Corpus (https://bartekstanda.github.io/ireland-price-index-2026/llms-full.txt)](https://bartekstanda.github.io/ireland-price-index-2026/llms-full.txt): Complete 2026 Euro pricing benchmarks, SEAI grants, Revenue Form Med 1 tax relief rules, Irish Building Regulations, and direct links for all 131 active .ie portals.
